title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 8 minutes.

title: Understanding of Light Travel
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of the speed of light and its travel time to Earth.

title: Comparison of Options
description: Important Criteria: The student should logically compare the given options to determine the most accurate answer.

title: Units of Time
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include appropriate units when stating the final answer.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as selecting 1 hour or 8 seconds as the answer.
